privacy_normalization: Only local absolute path prefixes were normalized: <REPO_ROOT> represents the source repository and <USER_HOME> represents the local user home. Original SHA-256 evidence hashes, numeric values, statuses, failures, outputs and limitations are preserved; unnormalized originals remain in ignored local release evidence.
